capabilities: Move heading branches and selected lines up and down with nested content
Promote or demote branches while preserving internal hierarchy
Fold branches and show the document up to a chosen heading depth
Renumber headings and lists, remove numbering, or fix skipped heading levels
Export the current branch to a separate Markdown note
disambiguation: Not just a heading outline viewer; it actively restructures the document by moving, releveling, and renumbering branches.
extras: README is written in Russian; only ATX headings are supported (no Setext), and file operations depend on the desktop environment and are of limited use on mobile.
intentEvidence: Панель структуры похожа на штатную outline-панель Obsidian, но добавляет управляющие действия.
problem: Obsidian's outline panel only displays the heading tree and offers no way to move, relevel, or renumber document sections directly.
summary: Markdown structure tool that moves, relevels, folds, and renumbers heading branches, with an outline sidebar and branch export to new notes.
